summary_md:
**Dante Martin ([@DanteMMartin](https://x.com/DanteMMartin/status/2115118061607141448))** points to an NVIDIA technical blog post on fine-tuning **Nemotron 3.5 Lightning** with persona-grounded local data so a 30B-class model learns *local rules* rather than just local languages.

His example: after tuning, the model gets a French Guiana passport-stamp fee right (€43 rather than €86). He notes the workflow runs on a single DGX Spark.

referenced_urls.title: Fine-Tuning NVIDIA Nemotron to Know Local Rules, Not Just Local Languages | NVIDIA Technical Blog

relevance: Shows the 30B Nemotron tier being fine-tuned (not just served) on one Spark, with an official NVIDIA walkthrough.
